text:
Mira Patel: Pager fired for sustained GPU queue backlog in eu-west-1 — latency spikes for generation endpoints + embedding jobs. Noticed after 09:10 UTC. Incidents Bot also showed autoscaler failed to add capacity twice. @AlexChen are you on call?

Incidents Bot: Alert 0x7c3 - inference-queue-delay > 500ms (eu-west-1) -> triggered at 2026-03-15T09:10:03Z. Autoscaler error: "rate limit exceeded".

Alex Chen: On it. Looking at autoscaler logs now. Preliminary: spot preemptions + cloud quota on GPUs causing failed scaleouts.

Jayden Ortiz: Seeing a large batch of long running embeddings from OmniRetail (customer tag: omni-retail-prod). They started a bulk reindex ~09:05 UTC.

CustSRE - OmniRetail: yes that's us — started a full catalog embeddings job, expected ~2h but seeing timeouts. We can pause if needed, tell us exactly which job id.

Mira Patel: Job id = job_24b7f. Please pause if possible; we need DIP to reduce customer impact.

Rana Singh: Quick ask — if we failover regions will OmniRetail observe higher latency? We need to coordinate cross-region routing.

Alex Chen: Two-part plan: 1) short-term: throttle heavy embedding job and free up slots in eu-west; 2) medium-term: trigger controlled failover of best-effort pools to eu-central while Dedicated customers stay in eu-west. Initiating rate limit on embeddings for omni-retail.

Product Ops: Notifying impacted customers now. "We are investigating elevated latency for inference in eu-west-1; a mitigation is in progress." CC @CustSRE - OmniRetail

Jayden Ortiz: Implementing throttle: setting customer throttle to 10 concurrent embeddings, lowering batch size to 256 for that job.

Alex Chen: Autoscaler log snippet: ```ERROR 2026-03-15T09:11:12Z autoscaler.go:412 scaleAttempt failed -> API quota error: "Insufficient quota for GPU v100"``` Also seeing a couple of preemption events from provider.

Mira Patel: OK, if quota is the root, failover to eu-central for non-Dedicated looks safest. Can infra create a temporary routing rule? DeployBot, can you spawn a regional route for inference-nonprod?

DeployBot: Started action: create-routing-rule -> route id r-983. Will take ~2 min to propagate.

Rana Singh: I'm updating the runbook: add note about distinguishing Dedicated vs Hosted routes during failover, to avoid moving reserved capacity.

Alex Chen: Ops step: spin up 8 gpus in eu-central on payg to absorb backlog, lower max_concurrency for embeddings cluster to prevent future queue buildup. Spawning instances now.

Incidents Bot: Scale event: 8 instances requested -> 6 succeeded, 2 failed (quota). Current backlog dropping by ~30% over last minute.

Jayden Ortiz: Backlog decreasing. Embedding job paced down, OmniRetail reports fewer timeouts.

CustSRE - OmniRetail: We see steady progress, thank you. Please confirm if any data cross-region will violate our policy.

Mira Patel: No model or customer data will cross regions. We will only route inference requests from hosted customers to eu-central; data retention remains in eu-west. Confirmed with infra.

Product Ops: Reached out to legal/Comms for a short bulletin.

Alex Chen: Action items being created: JIRA INF-3721 (regional failover for queued requests) owner @AlexChen, ETA 2026-03-20; JIRA INF-3722 (autoscaler robustness + quota handling) owner @RanaSingh, ETA 2026-03-18; JIRA INF-3723 (rate-limiting UX + per-cust throttles) owner @JaydenOrtiz, ETA 2026-03-22. Creating tickets now.

Jayden Ortiz: Added short-term run: add preemption-aware retry logic to autoscaler (basic backoff) and a fallback path to spawn payg instances if spot failures exceed threshold.

Rana Singh: Scheduling a post-incident review. Proposed: 2026-03-17 15:00 UTC, 45m. I'll set calendar invite and postmortem template: include timeline, root cause analysis (quota vs spot preemption), customer impact table, and remediation tracking.

Mira Patel: Please include customer impact notes: OmniRetail — embedding timeouts for 2k requests, elevated latency for hosted gen endpoints ~09:05-09:35 UTC.

Alex Chen: Add measurable mitigations we applied: paused job_24b7f at 09:13, throttled customer's concurrency at 09:14, spun up payg instances at 09:15, routing change propagation at 09:17. Backlog cleared by 09:32.

Product Ops: Drafting customer communication: we will state what happened, mitigation steps, and prevention work. Will circulate for review.

Incidents Bot: Incident closed -> severity: S2 (partial service degradation), duration: 27 minutes. Postmortem scheduled.

Mira Patel: Quick safety: add a proactive capacity check ahead of large customer reindex windows. Action: create monitoring alert for long running batch jobs with a pre-notify to SRE 30mins before large embeddings jobs (>500k items). Owner @JaydenOrtiz, JIRA INF-3724, ETA 2026-03-19.

Alex Chen: I'll follow up with cloud quota team about temporary bump and long-term quota plan.

Rana Singh: Closing notes: owners and JIRA ids in channel. We'll track remediation as subtasks of INF-3721. I'll run retrospective and include ops timeline.

Mira Patel: Thanks all. Marking this thread as action track. Please update Jira with progress and add any followups. :white_check_mark: :eyes:
